tagline: Enclosed Atezr diode with air assist : mid-budget safety focus
tldr: Atezr P2 competes with Acmer P3 and xTool S1 in the enclosed diode space. Decent engraving, moderate cutting. Less community documentation than xTool : verify support in your region.

editorialDepth.advantages: Atezr P2 20W is the versatile hobby / side-business SKU : clean engraving and light wood or leather cuts with comparable benchmarks on Maker Atlas.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you need clear cast acrylic, deep hardwood production, or a Class-1 story without planning filters and ducting. Open-frame safety and exhaust stay your responsibility even at 20W.
